character.name: Garrick Veyra
character.background: Disgraced noble, falsely accused of treason
traits: Stoic Resolve: Advantage on saving throws against being frightened
Unyielding Honesty: Cannot intentionally speak a falsehood, even to avoid harm or gain advantage
Oathbreaker's Mark: When you hit a creature with a weapon attack, that creature has disadvantage on all attack rolls against you until the end of its next turn
Guilt's Weight: You have disadvantage on Charisma (Deception) checks, but advantage on Charisma (Persuasion) checks when pleading a case of justice
character.gear: Heirloom longsword · Dented chain mail · Rusted iron shield · 3 days of dried venison · Tarnished cracked holy symbol · 50 ft hempen rope · Flint and steel · Folded parchment bearing House Veyra's royal seal
character.story: Once the youngest heir of noble House Veyra, Garrick swore a paladin's oath to protect the realm. Falsely accused of regicide by his uncle, he was stripped of his title, divine powers, and left for dead in the icy northern marches. He survived, but guilt festers: he broke his oath intentionally to protect his younger sister, the true murderer, a secret he has never revealed. Now he wanders frostbitten wilds, seeking proof of his innocence or his betrayer's throat. The broken oath burns cold in his chest, a reminder of the price of his sacrifice.

inventory.name: Heirloom longsword
inventory.lore: Forged by House Veyra's master smith three generations ago, this blade was passed to Garrick when he took his paladin's oath. The steel is etched with the family's raven crest, now half-scratched out by his own hands in despair after his disgrace.
inventory.description: A well-balanced longsword with a worn leather grip, the blade nicked from countless battles but still sharp.

inventory.name: Dented chain mail
inventory.lore: This chain mail was Garrick's standard issue as a knight of the realm, dented in the skirmish where he was ambushed and left for dead. The links are still stained with the mud of that frozen battlefield.
inventory.description: Interlocking metal links forming a heavy, protective shirt, dented in several places but still functional.

inventory.name: Rusted iron shield
inventory.lore: Bearing the same raven crest as his longsword, this shield was cracked when Garrick took a mace blow meant for a noble child during the ambush that framed him. He has never had it repaired, as a reminder of his failure to protect the innocent.
inventory.description: A heavy iron shield, rusted around the edges and bearing a large crack across its face from the blow that felled its former owner.

inventory.name: 3 days of dried venison
inventory.lore: Garrick hunted this venison in the northern marches while hiding from the king's men. It is tough and heavily salted, but it has kept him alive through the harsh winters of the frozen wilds.
inventory.description: Tough, dried strips of venison, heavily salted for preservation.

inventory.name: Tarnished cracked holy symbol
inventory.lore: This silver holy symbol of the paladin order was given to Garrick when he took his oath. It cracked the day his divine powers faded, and now it is cold to the touch, only faintly glowing when he is near those who have wronged him.
inventory.description: A tarnished silver medallion depicting a broken sword, cracked straight down the middle.
inventory.effects: When activated as an action, the symbol glows with faint silver light, revealing hidden undead and fiends within 30 ft for 1 minute. Can be used once per dawn.

inventory.name: 50 ft hempen rope
inventory.lore: This rope was stolen from a merchant's cart the night Garrick was framed, the first theft he ever committed. He keeps it as a reminder of how far he has fallen from his paladin ideals.
inventory.description: A coarse, sturdy hempen rope, frayed slightly at one end.

inventory.name: Flint and steel
inventory.lore: A simple flint and steel Garrick took from the body of a bandit who attacked him shortly after his exile. It has started more campfires than he can count in the frozen wilds.
inventory.description: A small piece of flint and a steel striker, worn smooth from use.

inventory.name: Folded parchment bearing House Veyra's royal seal
inventory.lore: This parchment bears the royal seal proving that the poison used in the framed regicide attempt came from his uncle's personal stores. Garrick has carried it for months, too afraid to show it to anyone for fear it will be stolen or disbelieved.
inventory.description: A folded piece of parchment, yellowed with age, bearing the official royal seal of the realm and the sigil of House Veyra.
